desc: Iris is a deaf, tech-modded assassin who had a large hand in shaping the city she lives in.

name: Luna
desc: Luna is the spark plug and an extremely capable leader of the Guild.

desc: Sonia is a genetically modified nanoscientist with exceptional intelligence and expertise in nanobiotechnology.

desc: Suzy is a formidable bounty assassin who is kind at heart. She has a soft spot for orphans and is willing to continue her profession to prevent them from having a similar childhood as hers.

name: Kassie
desc: A paranoid, eccentric neuroscientist who walks the line between good and evil. She is obsessed with electroshock therapies and follows her own set of rules.

name: Lila
desc: A cool, spry girl from the city of La Luna with excellent parkour skills and a playful nature. She likes to work with Mr. Waggor, outsmarting their foes together with clever pranks and innovative Gloo inventions.

desc: Hayato's younger sister, a skilled and calm ninja. As the second child of the Yagami family, she dwells in the shadow to keep her family's flame alive.

name: Ryden
desc: A 16-year-old genius inventor with knowledge beyond his age. Once a little boy who sought refuge under the protection of his sister, Suzy, he now bravely stands on the battlefield with his inventions.

name: Kairos
desc: A former soldier of the Special Forces. His fate took a sharp turn when encountering a mysterious energy source, which transformed his body and instilled a constant craving for more energy.

name: Koda
desc: Born in the arctic region, Koda was once led by a snow fox to find a mask embedded with advanced tech of his village. The nature-loving boy has longed for an adventure in the outside world. As he met Wolfrahh while playing games online and, later on, Leon and his sister, Koda began to explore what is beyond the familiar.

name: Oscar
desc: A brilliant, even slightly overachieving student by day and a beloved vigilante by night. With his flashy physical prowess, Oscar leaps through the shadows to take down the evil.

name: Free Fire Master League Divisi 1
desc: Free Fire Master League (FFML)  Divisi 1 is the highest league consisting of 18 professional teams in Indonesia. \n\nThe champions of FFML will represent the Indonesia region as the first seed. They will compete in the FFWS Finals.

name: Free Fire Indonesia Masters
desc: Free Fire Indonesia Masters (FFIM) is an open tournament for all Free Fire players in Indonesia.\n\nThe champions of FFIM will represent the Indonesia region as the second seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Brazilian League
desc:
Free Fire Brazilian League (LBFF) is Garena's premier Free Fire competition in Brazil. 

The champions of LBFF will represent the Brazil region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in LBFF will represent the Brazil region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire League
desc:
Free Fire League Latin America (FFL) is the ultimate Free Fire tournament in Latin America.

The champions of FFL will represent the LATAM region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in FFL will represent the LATAM region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Pakistan League
desc: Free Fire Pakistan League (FFPL) is the highest tier of tournaments for Free Fire in Pakistan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Pakistan League will represent the Pakistan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: VietNam Free Fire League
desc:
Vietnam Free Fire League (VFL) is the highest tier level of Free Fire Esports competition in Viet Nam.

The champions of VFL will represent the Vietnam region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in VFL will represent the Vietnam region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Europe Championship
desc: Free Fire Europe Championship (FFEC) is the highest level of Free Fire Esports competition in Europe.\n\nThe champions of FFEC will represent the Europe region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Arab League
desc:
Free Fire Arab League (FFAL) is the top league for the Free Fire pro-teams in the Middle East and North Africa .

The champions of FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: MCPS Majors
desc:
MCPS Majors is the top league for Malaysia, Cambodia, Philippines, and Sri Lanka region. 

The champions of MCPS Majors will represent the MCPS region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in MCPS Majors will represent the MCPS region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Pakistan League
desc: Free Fire Pakistan League (FFPL) is the highest tier of tournaments for Free Fire in Pakistan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Pakistan League will represent the Pakistan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Cup
desc: Free Fire Cup is an open tournament for all players in Taiwan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Cup will represent the Taiwan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: FFWS Championship
desc: The Play-ins will feature 9 teams battling it out to earn a spot at the Finals. The top 4 teams from the Play-ins will join the 8 top-seeded teams, and form the 12 teams who will compete to be winners of the FFWS 2022 Bangkok.\n\nThe teams will battle over 8 rounds – across 4 maps – to be the last one standing, with points awarded based on round ranking and the number of eliminations.
